changelog: - **The Timeline chart keeps a readable height.** Run notices and strips no longer squeeze the chart until its axis labels overlap: the area's least height now counts them, and when it is short they scroll inside, one notice row and one strip in view, while the chart keeps 140 px. The area now opens at that least height, 64 px taller than before for a document without notices or strips, so the canvas gives up the room; folding the area gives it back. In a 1440 × 900 window the gacha Pickup Template now opens too small to show its value chips; zooming in shows them.
